chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Drummers, pianists and guitarists he remembers
summary: Howard cannot recall many good drummers, praises Sonny Clay and Charlie Lawrence on piano, and knows no good guitarists.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
